  - main:
    - paragraph: LATTICE
    - heading "Command & Control" [level=1]
    - paragraph: COMMAND AND CONTROL
    - paragraph: Lattice for Command & Control (C2) is an AI-powered battle management platform built to accelerate complex kill chains.
    - paragraph: Lattice for C2 integrates thousands of sensors and effectors to turn data into decisions at scales and speeds beyond human capacity.
    - heading "Kill Chain" [level=5]
    - heading "01" [level=3]
    - figure: Lattice autonomously parsing data from thousands of sensors into a real-time intelligent common operating picture for battlespace understanding
    - heading "Understand" [level=6]
    - paragraph: Lattice creates a shared real-time understanding of the battlespace. It autonomously parses data from thousands of sensors & data sources into an intelligent common operating picture, all in a single pane of glass.
    - heading "02" [level=3]
    - figure: Lattice presenting AI-driven decision support to operators in a high-stakes dynamic environment, streamlining the decision-making process
    - heading "Decide" [level=6]
    - paragraph: Lattice streamlines the complexity of the decision-making process by presenting decision points -- not noise. Lattice leverages AI and deep learning models to present recommended decision support to operators in high-stakes and dynamic environments, where decisions must be made quickly.
    - heading "03" [level=3]
    - figure: Lattice turning operator decisions into action in seconds by tasking manned, unmanned, and autonomous assets across multiple domains
    - heading "Act" [level=6]
    - paragraph: Lattice turns decisions into action in seconds, not minutes or hours by tasking manned, unmanned, and autonomous assets across multiple domains, distributed geographies, and contested communications environments.
    - heading "Accelerate complex kill chains" [level=2]
    - heading "Features" [level=5]
    - heading "Built for Scale" [level=6]
    - figure
    - paragraph: Lattice can integrate, manage, and C2 thousands of sensors, effectors, networks, and mission systems globally across domains.
    - heading "All-Domain" [level=6]
    - figure
    - paragraph: Lattice integrates and operates across land, sea, air, and space to provide a comprehensive all-domain mission engine.
    - heading "Open & Extensible" [level=6]
    - figure
    - paragraph: Integrate third-party, legacy, and autonomous systems to work together in a single command and control mission engine.
    - heading "Intelligent & Secure Networking" [level=6]
    - figure
    - paragraph: Intelligent mesh networking ensures resilient, intelligent, and secure transport of mission critical data to and from the tactical edge.
    - heading "Battle Management Platform" [level=5]
    - figure: Lattice for Command and Control battle management platform enabling a single operator to supervise hundreds of autonomous systems simultaneously
    - text: "01"
    - heading "Built for Autonomy at Scale" [level=6]
    - paragraph: Lattice for C2 is the human machine interface built to meet the complexity and scale of operating manned, unmanned and autonomous systems. Lattice for C2 simplifies the fleet management of hundreds of systems, fuses thousands of data signals into operator insights, and turns a click of a button into action with machine-to-machine tasking.
    - text: "02"
    - heading "Disperse to Win" [level=6]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Lattice for C2 leverages a distributed mesh network,
      - link "Lattice Mesh":
        - /url: /lattice/lattice-mesh
      - text: ", to bring the realities of warfighters at the tactical edge back to the sensors and weapon systems operations centers. Lattice for C2 can be deployed across multiple modalities to meet the environment, ranging from laptops to tablets to operator-worn headsets."
    - text: "03"
    - heading "The Best of Today and Tomorrow" [level=6]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Lattice for C2 integrates legacy and next-generations sensors, effectors, networks, and mission systems in a bidirectional manner with the
      - link "Lattice SDK":
        - /url: /lattice/lattice-sdk
      - text: to provide an an intelligent, comprehensive, and capable common operating picture in a single pane of glass.
    - text: "04"
    - heading "AI Applied to the Fight" [level=6]
    - paragraph: Lattice for C2 leverages frontier AI technologies that enable natural operator interactions and decision aides to make rapid, confident, and effective decisions at machine speed.
    - heading "Hands-on Resources and Support" [level=5]
    - heading "Join" [level=6]
    - heading "Lattice Developer Experience" [level=6]
    - paragraph: Request to join the Lattice Developer Experience in order to get hands-on with Lattice Mesh services and to take your first steps towards developing applications and integrations.
    - link "Join the Lattice Developer Experience":
      - /url: https://dashboard.developer.anduril.com/
      - paragraph: Join the Lattice Developer Experience
    - link "Explore Lattice Docs":
      - /url: http://developer.anduril.com/
      - paragraph: Explore Lattice Docs
